summary: Mary Boston, wife of Thomas Lamoreaux Jr. (1787–1830).
bio: Mary Boston married Thomas Lamoreaux Jr., born at Monroe, New York, in 1787, a son of Ensign Thomas Lamoreaux and Keturah Tuttle.
